meaning: Dashboard data shows a refresh timestamp when loaded
Owner requests incidents and billing exceptions stay visible before secondary analytics
Critical admin and billing changes remain tied to existing audit and support records
Provider payment document and messaging activation stay gated until dependencies are verified
Draft submitted and reviewed handoff reports keep shift context explicit
Open tasks and shift notes are shown beside each handoff before review
Submitted and reviewed timestamps are recorded by the existing handoff update flow
Priority and blocked or open task status highlight manager attention needs
Support rows use opaque ticket references instead of exposing internal identifiers
Status changes assignments and notes remain audit logged by existing server controls
Support diagnostics do not create impersonation or hidden privilege in this gate
Internal note bodies stay in ticket records not audit metadata
The platform dashboard remains read only for operational review
Platform role and visible sections explain current admin capability
Activity feed and subscription health remain separate so one stale feed does not hide other proof
Admin health visibility does not activate launch payments provider access or messaging delivery
